title: Which SideKix squad would you join?
intro: Everyone is a bit of all five. One of them is where you would sit down first and stay longest.
og_line: Five questions and the table you would sit at.

cta.title: Something a bit more serious
cta.label: The Energy Discovery
cta.blurb: That one was for fun. The Energy Discovery is 48 statements and returns how you actually work across all twelve energies.

results.name: The Builders
results.headline: You would rather show it than describe it.
results.body: The fastest route to your point is a working version of it. You have ended more arguments with a demo than with a paragraph.
results.cost: Not everything that needed discussing got discussed.

results.name: The Dreamers
results.headline: You can see it finished already.
results.body: You hold the picture of what this becomes, which is the thing that keeps everyone going on a bad month.
results.cost: The gap between the picture and Tuesday is where people get discouraged.

results.name: The Hustlers
results.headline: You would rather move than meet.
results.body: Ten conversations, four follow ups, and something happened today. You measure a week by what changed in it.
results.cost: Motion looks like progress right up until it does not.

results.name: The Strategists
results.headline: You want to know why before how.
results.body: You are the person who asks the question that reframes the whole thing, usually twenty minutes in.
results.cost: The question sometimes arrives after everyone has already committed.

results.name: The Community Champions
results.headline: You build the room, not just the thing.
results.body: You know who should meet whom, and you make it happen without being asked. The network is the asset.
results.cost: You give away more time than you count, and nobody sends an invoice for it.
